content.title: Sidemen Charity Match 2026 LIVE: Result and updates after penalty shootout settles Wembley thriller
content.text: The annual Sidemen Charity Match produced another thrilling contest at Wembley Stadium on Saturday. One of the hottest tickets in the capital sold out fast once again with 90,000 fans watching the always fun influencer friendly at the home of English football, where a record 20 goals were scored in an entertaining spectacle between Sidemen FC and the YouTube Allstars, who this year had Sidemen members KSI, Miniminter and Behzinga all in their ranks in a twist.ItalianBach’s late equaliser for 10-10 led to another penalty shootout, which the Allstars won for the second year in a row as Mrwhosetheboss dispatched the triumphant spot-kick following misses by Jack Joseph and LazarBeam. Jynxzi was man of the match after scoring twice, while Miniminter’s hat-trick deservedly earned him the Golden Boot award.More than £6million was raised for charities Bright Side and M7 Education on a day to remember in London, where Max Fosh made Mark Clattenburg’s yellow card spectacularly disappear in a burst of flames in a headline-grabbing moment. Follow reaction to the latest Sidemen Charity Match live below!Sidemen Charity Match 2026 latest newsKSI and the YouTube Allstars lift the Sidemen Charity Match trophy at Wembley...KSI announces the final total raised after today’s game - £6,218,875.Miniminter receives his Golden Boot trophy from Michelle Agyemang before the YouTube Allstars - led by KSI - hoist the trophy aloft on the Wembley balcony for the second year in a row, then doing so again on the pitch.Getting those three Sidemen players has certainly worked out well!Quite the redemption story for Jynxzi, who struggled at Wembley last year but earned back his place and now gets man of the match for his two goals, handed over by KSI.Sidemen FC have been up to collect their second-place medals.Sidemen FC’s Niko Omilana jokes about challenging Mark Clattenburg to a boxing match after his wrongly disallowed early goal.How big a decision that turned out to be in the end!Behzinga also confirmed that he was injured after team-mate and penalty shootout hero Mrwhosetheboss accidentally went into his ankle.Sidemen FC 10-10 YouTube Allstars (1-4 pens)A superb penalty from Mrwhosetheboss, into the bottom corner past xQc and the YouTube Allstars have won the Sidemen Charity Match via a shootout for the second year in a row.Sidemen FC 10-10 YouTube Allstars (1-3 pens)No messing around from ChrisMD, who rolls in a first successful penalty for Sidemen FC.Mrwhosetheboss could win it for the YouTube Allstars...Sidemen FC 10-10 YouTube Allstars (0-3 pens)Max Fosh fires in another for the YouTube Allstars with his left foot!3-0 in the shootout. Sidemen FC must now score.Sidemen FC 10-10 YouTube Allstars (0-2 pens)Up steps LazarBeam for Sidemen FC... over the crossbar!
